notes: Levels 4 and 5: the wall and its gates now sit where you build them in Level 3.
The reactor lamp now sits in the reactor in Levels 1-5 instead of floating above it.
Level 3: once coins are waiting, the arrow points at the register where you stand to sell and collect them.
Level 3: the road-and-kiosk line now plays only once you are right at the kiosk, so the kiosk is always on screen whichever way you walk up to it.
Level 2: once you hook a pod, the pointer now leads you home to the heat instead of staying on the pod's starting spot.
Levels menu: levels with more than 3 stars now show your count as 5/8 instead of a row of stars.
